missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: We’ve located an Imperial convoy! Using the latest data from the Rand Ecliptic’s command computer we’ve been able to pinpoint the rough time and location of the next Imperial convoy. The data’s not exact, so we will be splitting the attack force into three groups. Red squadron with the Redemption, Gold squadron with the Bixby, and the newly formed Blue Squadron with the Rand Ecliptic. Each group will fan out and investigate a number of possible locations for the convoy, when one group finds the convoy, they will send a transmission to the other two groups, and all three groups will converge on the convoy. Remember, the aim is to hit the convoy, try to avoid directly engaging any escort craft or support ships.
This is Red Leader. All ships accounted for...
Proceed with the flight plan and good luck.
Okay Red Squadron. Head to the first waypoint. Keep your eyes peeled.
Okay head to the jump point.
Check it out, an old Venator. Man this things vintage.
Do you want a closer look?
This thing doesn't look like it's moved in years.
How is it even still here? Thing must be worth a ton in scrap...
the galaxy is a big place...
You think we're the first to find it since it was abandoned?
Maybe, maybe not. You'd need to have some serious equipment to drag this thing to a scrap hauler.
Hey, maybe it's part of the Katana fleet.
No, I don't think... the Katana fleet was made of dreadnaughts.
Okay enough speculation... head to the next jump point.
Red One I'm picking up a signal from search group three.
This is Search Group Three. We have engaged the enemy. Repeat we have engaged the enemy. Request immediate assistance.
Red Two. Calculate a jump. All fighters prepare for combat.
Sending you the jump coordinates now.
Thanks Two. All ships jump when you reach the waypoint. We'll reform on the other side.
Focus on protecting our bombers. The Redemption and the Bixby will engage the Intrepid and try to draw it's fire.
Okay Red Squadron. Join the attack on the convoy.
This is Blue Squadron. Here to assist.
Thanks Blue Squadron. Target those transports. We'lll cover you.
The Intrepid is powering up it's Hyperdrive.
All squadrons. Mission success. Follow your flight leaders instructions to return to base.
You heard him Red Squadron. Head for the jump point and we're done.

Well done Red, Gold, and Blue squadrons. Thanks to your efforts we’ve almost certainly set back the completion date on this secret imperial project. The material the convoy was carrying suggests the project may be some kind of battle station or space fortress, but probably bigger than the standard golan design. What they are planning to do with it, we don’t know…
